New South Wales launches major gun buyback after Bondi attack

New South Wales, Australia, is launching its largest gun buyback program in decades. The initiative follows the Bondi Junction Westfield shopping centre attack. The program is funded through a deal between the state government and the federal government. The specific details of the funding agreement were not disclosed in the coverage.
